answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive guide to getting **free satellite radio** in 2026:

---

## 🛰️ Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Trial (In-Car)**
SiriusXM offers a free 3-month trial subscription that includes every channel — including every premium channel — plus access inside and outside the car and on the app.

- The car satellite radio option will ask for your VIN, but that's it — no credit card required.
- This offer is available only on qualifying inactive radios as determined solely by SiriusXM.

---

### 2. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Streaming Trial (App)**
SiriusXM also offers 3 months free of SiriusXM Streaming, which is a $29.97 value.

- While the in-car offer gives you satellite radio in your car, the streaming offer gives you the same radio accessible on your phone, tablet, and computer.
- The streaming option will ask for a credit card, but it won't charge you until the 3 months is over.

---

### 3. **New Car Trial**
If you just drove off the lot in a shiny new car, chances are that SiriusXM Satellite Radio is a standard feature on your radio and free of charge for a certain period of time.

If you just bought a new car, chances are you have SiriusXM for free for three months. There are also discount programs that can get you free access for a limited period of time.

---

### 4. **What You Get with Free Trials**
Both free offers give you hundreds of channels of ad-free music curated by genre, era, and even artist-inspired channels. You'll also have access to live sports — including MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, & college sports — plus original talk shows, news coverage, interviews, podcasts, and much more.

---

### 5. **SiriusXM Free Listen Events**
SiriusXM occasionally offers completely free listening events (for example, a recent one ran May 21 – June 1), letting anyone listen to great music, sports analysis, comedy, and more. Keep an eye on SiriusXM's website for the next free listen window.

---

### 6. **Free Alternatives to Satellite Radio**
If you're looking for **permanently free** options, consider these streaming services as alternatives:
- Streaming services like **Pandora**, **Spotify**, and **Apple Music** have taken ownership of the music industry and are the go-to options for hard-core music listeners.
- Services like **Apple Podcasts** and **Stitcher** stream even more specific talk listening right to your phone, offering variety that SiriusXM just can't.

---

### ⚠️ Keep in Mind
There are a whole lot of places where streaming services just don't work — you're depending on a signal on your phone. If you're out in the middle of nowhere, you'll be disappointed relying solely on streaming. You can start in California and end up in Massachusetts and listen to the same SiriusXM channel coast to coast with barely an interruption, because it's satellite-based and the whole country is covered.

---

**Bottom Line:** The best way to get free satellite radio is to take advantage of SiriusXM's **free 3-month trial** — either in-car (no credit card needed) or via the app. Visit [siriusxm.com/free-trial](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial) to get started!
